steps.name: Checkout candidate runtime and frozen harness
Check physical CPU and compiled profile prerequisites
Restore complete pair and project the fixed manifest
Attest actual runtime flags and backend on this host
Install compiler for actual AVX-512 native contract checks
Execute native AVX-512 contract on this physical host
Measure sequential original enabled and disabled triplets
Measure the separate external ABC fixture on the same complete images
Measure applicable external UTF-16 negative probe controls
Retain every raw result and unsupported-host receipt
Post Checkout candidate runtime and frozen harness
